summary.business_type: Local Service — Home Repair (Plumbing + Electrical), Hybrid SAB
top_findings: E-E-A-T critically weak: zero author attribution on 42 articles, no license numbers displayed, company only 5 months old
Local SEO infrastructure nearly absent: no verified GBP, no city-level landing pages, NAP inconsistency across 3 offices
Schema breadcrumb URLs broken on /water/ service pages (invalid # anchor)
404 page is indexable with canonical, hreflang, and BreadcrumbList — sends wrong signals to Google
AI search readiness low (41/100): no llms.txt, no HowTo schema, articles bury direct answers after intros
quick_wins: Add noindex to 404 page and strip hreflang from it (1 file change)
Fix broken breadcrumb URLs on /water/ pages (replace # with correct path)
Add width/height to 9 images missing dimensions (CLS fix)
Reduce homepage image preloads from 6 to 2 (hero only)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Astro SSG — full HTML in raw response, zero JS execution required by Googlebot
LCP hero image has fetchpriority=high, loading=eager, and rel=preload
System font stack eliminates font-related render blocking
All 33 redirect rules in vercel.json return 301
Responsive images with srcset, 44px touch targets, mobile nav

findings.title: 404 page is indexable
findings.description: Custom /404/ page has no noindex directive, carries self-referencing canonical, hreflang alternates, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
findings.recommendation: Add <meta name='robots' content='noindex,follow'> to 404 layout; remove hreflang alternates

findings.title: 9 images missing width/height attributes
findings.description: Without explicit dimensions, browser cannot reserve space before images load — causes CLS
findings.recommendation: Add dimensions to every tag; prefer Astro's component

findings.title: X-Frame-Options contradicts CSP frame-ancestors
findings.description: vercel.json sets X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN but CSP sets frame-ancestors 'none'
findings.recommendation: Change X-Frame-Options to DENY to match CSP intent

findings.title: 2-hop redirect for http://setsubi-pro.net/
findings.description: http://setsubi-pro.net/ → https://setsubi-pro.net/ → https://www.setsubi-pro.net/ (2 hops)
findings.recommendation: Add direct Vercel redirect from http://setsubi-pro.net/ to https://www.setsubi-pro.net/

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.description: Site publishes articles frequently via automated pipeline but sends no IndexNow signals
findings.recommendation: Generate key, place key file at domain root, POST new URLs in generateWorker.ts

findings.title: CSP uses unsafe-inline for script-src and style-src
findings.description: Neutralizes most XSS protection due to inline script blocks
findings.recommendation: Move inline scripts to external modules, tighten to nonce or strict-dynamic

findings.title: 14 images without loading attribute
findings.description: Default eager loading means below-fold images compete with above-fold resources
findings.recommendation: Add loading=lazy to all images outside initial viewport

findings.title: 6 image preloads on homepage (excessive)
findings.description: Only hero pair needs preloading; 4 sanitary service images are not above-fold on mobile
findings.recommendation: Remove preloads for sanitary_01-04, keep only hero mobile+desktop

findings.title: HSTS missing preload; max-age inconsistent
findings.description: Canonical returns max-age=31536000; non-www returns max-age=63072000. Neither includes preload
findings.recommendation: Standardize to max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload

findings.title: CORS wildcard on HTML responses
findings.description: access-control-allow-origin: * on HTML documents exposes pages to cross-origin fetch
findings.recommendation: Scope CORS wildcard to asset paths only

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 42 column articles all exceed thin content threshold (min 2,046 JP chars, avg 3,455)
Article titles are well-crafted (question format, high specificity)
Articles have clear H2/H3 diagnostic hierarchies
FAQ page has 30+ self-contained Q&A pairs

findings.title: Zero author attribution on all 42 column articles
findings.description: Under Sept 2025 QRG, anonymous technical content on safety-adjacent topics (electrical/plumbing) is a direct E-E-A-T liability. FAQ mentions 国家資格 but no license types, names, or certificate numbers appear anywhere
findings.recommendation: Add author/supervisor attribution to all articles; create a staff credentials page with qualification details

findings.title: E-E-A-T composite score critically low (44/100)
findings.description: Company only 5 months old, no outbound authority links (only 1 found across 42 articles), NAP inconsistency, no license numbers displayed
findings.recommendation: Display contractor license numbers, add external citations to articles, build author expertise pages

findings.title: Duplicate testimonial detected
findings.description: Two voice entries for 給湯器交換 大阪市阿倍野区 ¥19,800 have near-identical body text under different initials (Y.T.様 / T.N.様)
findings.recommendation: Verify and remove duplicate; audit remaining testimonials for similar issues

findings.title: Meta descriptions leave 60-80 chars unused
findings.description: Non-article pages have 76-84 char descriptions, consistently leaving SERP space unused
findings.recommendation: Expand descriptions to 120-155 chars with specific keywords and value propositions

findings.title: Columns index page skips H2 level
findings.description: H1 → H3 heading hierarchy violation on /columns/ listing page
findings.recommendation: Add categorical H2 headings to group articles by topic

findings.title: Company about page is thin (817 JP chars)
findings.description: Only page below thin content threshold — just a company table with two boilerplate paragraphs
findings.recommendation: Expand with company story, team qualifications, service philosophy details

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Canonical tags correctly implemented sitewide
Hreflang (ja + x-default) present
RSS feed available
OG tags properly configured
Internal linking: 95 unique internal links on homepage

findings.title: No city-level landing pages
findings.description: Zero city or prefecture pages despite serving 10+ prefectures. Cannot rank for [city]+[service] queries — the dominant pattern in Japanese local home services search
findings.recommendation: Create location pages starting with Tokyo and Osaka, then remaining prefectures

findings.title: No pricing tables on service pages
findings.description: Competitors show ¥7,500-¥12,000 ranges in SERP snippets. WEB割引 ¥5,000 coupon buried in FAQ, not on service pages
findings.recommendation: Add pricing tables to service pages; promote WEB割引 prominently

findings.title: No pinned mobile CTA (tap-to-call)
findings.description: Emergency users must scroll to find phone number. For a 24/7 emergency service, this is a critical conversion gap
findings.recommendation: Add sticky bottom bar with tap-to-call button on mobile

findings.title: Articles bury direct answers after problem-description intros
findings.description: Most articles start with sympathy/problem intro instead of answering the title question directly. One article (air-conditioner-suddenly-stop-working) does it right
findings.recommendation: Rewrite article intros to lead with direct answer; use the working article as template

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization + WebSite JSON-LD on every page
LocalBusiness schema with 3 office locations
FAQPage schema on homepage and FAQ page
Article schema on column pages with headline, image, datePublished, author
BreadcrumbList on all inner pages
Proper ISO 8601 dates, correct openingHours format

findings.title: Broken breadcrumb URLs on /water/ pages
findings.description: BreadcrumbList items have 'item': 'https://www.setsubi-pro.net#' — invalid # anchor URL. Will fail Google Rich Results Test
findings.recommendation: Fix breadcrumb component to output correct path URLs for water service pages

findings.title: Hyogo LocalBusiness has no streetAddress or postalCode
findings.description: Google requires streetAddress for Local Business rich results eligibility
findings.recommendation: Add real street address for Hyogo office or remove that LocalBusiness entry

findings.title: Trailing slash inconsistency in schema URLs
findings.description: LocalBusiness.url, Article.publisher.url, BreadcrumbList items use no trailing slash while canonical uses trailing slash
findings.recommendation: Standardize all schema URLs to match canonical format (with trailing slash)

findings.title: No @id on WebSite and LocalBusiness entities
findings.description: Prevents clean cross-referencing in the entity graph; Article duplicates Organization data instead of referencing by @id
findings.recommendation: Add @id to all entities and use $ref linking

findings.title: Missing AggregateRating in LocalBusiness
findings.description: 30+ testimonials exist but no star ratings, no aggregate rating schema. Competitors show stars in SERP
findings.recommendation: Add star ratings to testimonials and implement AggregateRating schema

findings.title: No HowTo schema on step-by-step articles
findings.description: Many diagnostic articles follow step-by-step format but lack HowTo schema for featured snippet eligibility
findings.recommendation: Add HowTo schema to applicable column articles

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP: hero image correctly configured with fetchpriority=high + preload
No web fonts — system font stack eliminates FOIT/FOUT
Astro SSG delivers pre-rendered HTML with minimal JS
Vercel serves with Brotli compression

findings.title: CLS risk from 9 images without dimensions
findings.description: Images without width/height cause layout shifts as they load
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height attributes to all images

findings.title: Excessive image preloads competing for bandwidth
findings.description: 6 preloads on homepage; only hero pair is above-fold on mobile
findings.recommendation: Reduce to 2 preloads (hero variants only)

findings.title: Homepage HTML is 262.9 KB
findings.description: Duplicated mobile/desktop nav markup and inline JSON-LD contribute to size
findings.recommendation: Monitor; acceptable with Brotli but reduce if it grows

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers implicitly allowed via robots.txt
Static Astro SSG — no JS rendering barrier for AI crawlers
Comprehensive sitemap (112 URLs)
FAQ answers are within optimal 134-167 word AI citation window

findings.title: No llms.txt present (404)
findings.description: No machine-readable summary for AI assistants to reference the brand accurately
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with curated service/area/content index

findings.title: No YouTube presence
findings.description: YouTube has highest correlation (~0.737) with AI citation frequency. Critical for home repair topics
findings.recommendation: Start YouTube channel with repair demonstration and diagnostic videos

findings.title: Zero external citations in articles
findings.description: No sourced statistics or authority references across 42 articles
findings.recommendation: Add manufacturer references, industry statistics, and regulatory citations

findings.title: Article dates not in ISO 8601 format in visible text
findings.description: Dates display as YYYY.M.D — not machine-readable in visible content (OK in schema)
findings.recommendation: Use <time datetime='...'> elements wrapping the visible date

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0 images missing alt text entirely
Responsive images with srcset on key images
Hero image properly prioritized

findings.title: 10 images with empty alt text
findings.description: Empty alt='' is correct only for decorative images; verify these are truly decorative
findings.recommendation: Audit each empty-alt image; add descriptive alt for content-bearing images

findings.title: 9 images missing width/height
findings.description: Causes CLS and poor performance scores
findings.recommendation: Add dimensions; use Astro <Image /> component

findings.title: 14 images without loading attribute
findings.description: Below-fold images load eagerly by default
findings.recommendation: Add loading=lazy to below-fold images

critical_issues: NAP inconsistency: footer shows Ibaraki, company/about leads with Osaka
Hyogo office has no street address
Operating name inconsistency: 設備プロ vs 株式会社Hoaloha（設備プロ）
Zero city-level landing pages for 10+ service prefectures
Testimonials lack star ratings, dates, and Review schema

sxo.key_finding: Trust-authority mismatch: 5-month-old company competing against marketplaces with 13,000+ verified reviews

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix broken breadcrumb URLs on /water/ pages (replace # with correct path)
Add noindex,follow to 404 page layout; strip hreflang
Resolve NAP: choose one canonical primary address; apply sitewide in footer and schema
Change X-Frame-Options to DENY in vercel.json
Fix duplicate testimonial on /voice/ pages
Add 301 redirects for dead column slugs (aircon-lamp-blinking, toilet-flush-weak)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add author/supervisor attribution to all 42 column articles
Create staff credentials page with qualification details and license numbers
Display contractor license numbers in footer and service pages
Add width/height to all images missing dimensions
Add loading=lazy to 14 below-fold images
Reduce homepage preloads from 6 to 2
Add AggregateRating + star ratings to testimonials
Add HowTo schema to step-by-step diagnostic articles
Create /llms.txt with service/area/content index
Add pinned mobile CTA bar (tap-to-call) for emergency users
Add pricing tables to service pages; promote WEB割引 coupon

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Create city-level landing pages (Tokyo, Osaka first, then remaining prefectures)
Create and verify GBP listings for Kanto and Osaka offices
Expand company/about page with team qualifications and company story
Add external citations to articles (manufacturer refs, industry stats)
Rewrite article introductions to lead with direct answers
Expand meta descriptions to 120-155 chars on non-article pages
Register on Japanese citations: くらしのマーケット, ユアマイスター, Yahoo!ロコ
Implement IndexNow for automated publish notifications
Fix @id linking in schema entity graph

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Start YouTube channel with repair demonstration videos
Create LINE Official Account for customer communication
Tighten CSP from unsafe-inline to nonce-based
Standardize HSTS with preload directive; submit to hstspreload.org
Monitor CWV field data when Google API credentials are configured
Create emergency service landing pages targeting 緊急 queries
Scope CORS wildcard to asset paths only
Build drift baseline for ongoing SEO monitoring
